publicAccess.note: Set enabled to true to expose the mobile QR code over the public internet (via a Cloudflare tunnel) instead of requiring the phone to be on the same WiFi as this desktop. On in this install; set enabled to false for LAN-only access. Requires internet access on this machine. All API routes require login either way. mode: "quick" (default, random trycloudflare.com URL that changes on every restart) or "named" (stable hostname; also set namedTunnel.token and namedTunnel.hostname from the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard).

mapBoundingBox.note: Centered on NBSC's actual campus coordinates (8.359999, 124.868103), Manolo Fortich, Bukidnon — good enough to center the Cluster Map's tile download and initial view, but not a precise per-building survey. Run 'npm run tiles:fetch' after adjusting this so the map works offline; use the Cluster Map screen's PLACE ON MAP button per room to pin each room's exact spot once you can see real buildings on the map.

tileProvider.note: Put the tile provider's API key in settings.local.json (git-ignored), never in this file. See settings.local.example.json.

recovery.note: The superadmin's one-time recovery code is emailed here. Put the real email and the SMTP App Password in settings.local.json (git-ignored), never in this file.
